BiblicalUsage: Choriy is white bread, and it stands once in the dream of Pharaoh's chief baker. He sees three white baskets on his head, and the birds eat the bakemeats out of the uppermost basket, a dream that Joseph reads as three days to the baker's death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the white bread in the dream is the baker's own craft turned against him, because the birds eat what he made, and Joseph's reading shows God's hand in every detail, even in a basket of bread.
